jamie: Heads-up: sudden surge of low-confidence SAST alerts. Many clusters missing `kms_audit_id` — grouping diverged.

noor: saw it. scanner service account lost KMS decrypt in yesterday's RBAC prune. Evidence bundles incomplete so dedupe fails.

kai: mitigation suggestions: 1) temporary decrypt grant for scanner-sa (30m) 2) suppression rule for low-confidence findings without kms_audit_id in prod-staging for 6h 3) backfill job to attach audit ids and re-run grouping.

jamie: can we also add a `evidence_enriched` flag in webhook so UI shows which clusters need backfill?

noor: yes, will add `kms_audit_ids` + `evidence_enriched:false` to webhook. PR link when ready.

kai: created suppressor SUPP-2777 and scheduled short-lived grant. audit-bot: exporting decrypt logs for last 72h for backfill mapping.

scanner-bot: scan payload: id=scan-2026-03-21-1201, sast_low=96, kms_audit_id=null, evidence_enriched=false

jamie: owners: noor (grant + backfill), kai (suppressor + PD routing), jamie (runbook update). We'll revert grant after backfill + 24h stability.

(reacts: jamie :white_check_mark:, noor :rocket:, scanner-bot :robot_face:)
